analyzed_vuln.description: Heap-use-after-free is caused by IRNode::NodeData::cleanup destroying BlockData (which owns a shared_ptr<SymbolTable>) before expression nodes that still contain VariableReference objects are destroyed. Releasing the SymbolTable frees Variable objects first; later, VariableReference::~VariableReference calls Variable::referenceDestroyed on a dangling Variable pointer, producing UAF (crash observed in SkSLVariable.h:123-128). The root issue is incorrect destruction/lifetime ordering in NodeData cleanup/IR node teardown, not the decrement itself.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Triggered when malformed SkSL parsed by sksl2spirv creates IR where VariableReference nodes outlive the SymbolTable that owns their Variable symbols during program teardown. In this PoC, fuzz input builds nested expressions (including array indexing and function calls with local arrays), then on compiler/program destruction, BlockData cleanup drops SymbolTable early; subsequent recursive destruction of expression/statement trees invokes VariableReference destructors that touch freed Variable memory.
